summary: mixture of quasi-incompressible elastic solids; stress = sum of solids' stresses; bulk modulus = sum of the `<solid>` bulk moduli (a `<k>` outside `<solid>` is **ignored**). `mat_axis` may be given at `<material>` level (local element axes rel. global) and/or within each `<solid>` (local material axes rel. element); they compound. Material axes in `<ElementData>` ≡ specification at `<material>` level. Each `<solid>` may itself be any material from §4.1.2.
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.1.2.16 Uncoupled Solid Mixture, p193（4.13）

solid.meaning: Container tag for solid material (any number)
solid.note: 手册列出该参数，但 pyfebio 当前版本没有对应字段，建模时无法传入。

example.source: pyfebio 默认值不足以构造出该材料，需人工补全必要参数后给出示例。
